title: phone
description: sessionphone's host settings (phone.json and phone.d/*.json): one map per bot under `bots`, every value a JSON string. Installed beside phone.json by `sessionphone bot install`; the package owns it, so nobody edits the copy.

bots.description: One map per bot, named by its agent (DC_AGENT). A DC_* key is an environment setting `bot install` keeps; download_limit, download_types and save_dir are host-only keys, read from these files alone and never from the environment.

download_limit.description: The largest attachment, in bytes (decimal digits), the bot fetches and passes on without being asked. "0" means no limit. Host-only.

download_types.description: The attachment kinds passed on without being asked, comma-separated: image, sticker, voice, audio, video, file, webxdc, vcard; or "none". Absent: every kind. Host-only.

save_dir.description: The folder a passed-on attachment is copied to: an absolute path, `~` allowed. Absent: <home>/attachments, under the bot's own state root. Host-only.

_locked.description: Dotted key paths (bots.<agent>.<key>, or bots.<agent>) a later file and `bot install` may not change.
